title: The Longevity Effects Of Psilocybin
description:
Could psilocybin be a potential longevity therapy?

This was the most quantified psychedelic experiment ever done. My team and I tracked 249 biomarkers over the course of two medically supervised doses of psilocybin (magic mushrooms), which allowed us to identify several first-in-human observations. Some results surprised us.

0:00 Introduction
0:30 Bryan’s Adventures
2:22 Discovery
6:29 Doubt
9:45 Surrender
15:13 Afterglow
19:55 Escalation
24:00 Evidence: What 249 Biomarkers Showed
30:57 Onward

Psilocybin is a controlled substance in most countries and can cause serious psychological reactions, particularly for people with a personal or family history of psychosis or bipolar disorder. Please don't attempt this on your own. Findings need replication. Not medical advice.
